objective: Exhaustive multi-disciplinary audit of Kalam Whitepaper and Architecture across Systems, Algorithms, Security, UX, and Claims Integrity
audience: Torob Hackathon Judges, Technical Architects, Security Auditors, and Product Leads
questions: Q1: Systems & Performance Architecture Audit - Is the SQLite FTS5 + in-memory engine sound, scalable, and verifiable under real concurrent load?
Q2: Mathematical & Algorithmic Rigor Audit - Are the 7 proprietary algorithms (IP-CRP, PACO, IMWP, CrediPay, INDP, SVDP, TFRA) mathematically sound, computationally bounded, and resilient?
Q3: Security & Anti-Gaming Audit - Are the 5-layer guardrails, anti-sabotage filters, and prompt injection defenses robust against adversarial manipulation?
Q4: Physical Urban UX & Offline Resilience Audit - Does the mobile journey truly solve the chaotic realities of Tehran malls and dead-zone basements?
Q5: Claims Trace & Rubric Compliance Audit - Are all performance, speed, and feature claims in the whitepaper strictly verifiable against the codebase and dataset?
scope: Kalam Whitepaper (WHITEPAPER.md), architecture specs, dataset (dataset.zip), and local algorithms
constraints: Strict peer-review standard without defensive bias
Actionable remediation for every identified flaw

acceptance.description: Rigorous technical audit of systems architecture, memory limits, and latency claims
Mathematical and algorithmic proof check of all 7 algorithms with complexity bounds
acceptance.required_evidence_kind: formal algorithmic analysis and stress tests

acceptance.description: Adversarial threat modeling and anti-gaming audit
acceptance.required_evidence_kind: threat models and exploit scenario testing

acceptance.description: Physical usability and offline fault-tolerance review
acceptance.required_evidence_kind: ux heuristics and offline state verification

acceptance.description: Systematic claims-trace audit classifying claims into Active, Planned, and Suspected
acceptance.required_evidence_kind: claims.trace gate findings and constructive remediation
